responsibility: Provides the post-rule support code for the COBOL scanner, especially the bridge between normal tokenization and the CDF subparser. It names Flex start conditions for debugging, recognizes special datetime format literals, decides which tokens belong to compiler directives, runs ydfparse recursively when directive tokens are encountered, manages lookahead and parser/scanner state restoration, and implements yylex’s final token filtering around conditional compilation and NEXT SENTENCE handling.
